meta.title: Items selected on different pages of the PR list are all counted

steps.note: Enable the required team-category filtering configuration for the PR list.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen, the required entry point for this case.
Keep the PR list on the Open tab.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions list, select the PR-1 item on page 1, move to page 2, select the PR-2 item, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, and stop with the Search a user dialog showing the combined assignment list for both selected PRs.

steps.note: Perform the cross-page selection and assignment flow that no dedicated catalog step models.
Confirm the Assign flow opened the user-search interface after both PRs were selected.
